User_Story: As a user, I want secure login and logout so that only my authenticated session can act.
Acceptance_Criteria: Valid login returns opaque session cookie; invalid credentials yield generic error; logout revokes session; passwords hashed via bcrypt.

User_Story: As an administrator, I want controlled role management so that warehouse privileges remain strictly enforced.
Acceptance_Criteria: Only ADMIN can update roles; customer role self-elevation rejected with 403; role changes revoke active sessions and are audited.

User_Story: As a manager, I want to maintain products and locations so that stock and tasks use valid warehouse geometry.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unique SKU; positive product weight; unique location code and coordinates; obstacle definitions validated.

User_Story: As an operator, I want to view available and reserved stock so that I can judge fulfillment readiness.
Acceptance_Criteria: Available stock computed as on_hand - reserved; customers cannot access internal stock balances; search is bounded.

User_Story: As a customer, I want an order to reserve all required items atomically so that fulfillment cannot oversell inventory.
Acceptance_Criteria: Positive bounded quantities; all-or-none database transaction; competing concurrent requests prevent negative balance; replay safe.

User_Story: As a manager, I want registered robot identities so that only known devices receive tasks.
Acceptance_Criteria: Unique robot serial; high-entropy bearer token stored only as SHA-256 digest; inactive robots excluded from dispatch.

User_Story: As an auditor, I want attributable security events so that sensitive changes can be investigated.
Acceptance_Criteria: Authentication failures, role changes, stock adjustments, and task dispatches recorded with UTC timestamp and actor ID.

User_Story: As a customer, I want to see my own order status so that I know whether fulfillment succeeded.
Acceptance_Criteria: Owner-filtered order list and receipt; cross-customer IDOR access yields 404; clear pending/fulfilled/exception states.

User_Story: As a developer, I want a secure reproducible build so that changes can be reviewed and checked.
Acceptance_Criteria: Locked dependencies; zero hardcoded secrets; Bandit static analysis and pytest test suites executed.

User_Story: As an operator, I want atomic robot assignment so that competing requests cannot create conflicting work.
Acceptance_Criteria: Only eligible idle robots assigned; partial unique index enforces 1 active task per robot; concurrent requests safely rejected.

User_Story: As a robot service, I want safe pickup and movement commands so that reserved goods reach packing without collisions.
Acceptance_Criteria: Task-bound sequenced commands; mutual cell exclusion on discrete 2D grid; direct swap rejected; drop confirmed at packing bay.

User_Story: As an operator, I want heartbeat and fault handling so that stale robots stop receiving unsafe work.
Acceptance_Criteria: Heartbeat age > 30s transitions robot to OFFLINE; robot preserves ownership of in-transit inventory; alert logged.

User_Story: As a manager, I want controlled stock adjustments so that counted inventory can be corrected without silent manipulation.
Acceptance_Criteria: Mandatory reason code; positive delta bounds; cannot reduce below reserved stock; appends to immutable movement ledger.

User_Story: As an operator, I want safe pause and cancellation so that work can stop without losing or duplicating goods.
Acceptance_Criteria: Operational pause halts all movements under lock; pre-pickup cancel releases reserved stock atomically; post-pickup holds for review.

User_Story: As a manager, I want fulfillment results so that I can verify goods arrived in packing.
Acceptance_Criteria: Delivered stock matches source order items; order status marked FULFILLED only after packing drop committed.

User_Story: As a maintainer, I want hardened Docker and Kubernetes deployment so that the application runs with limited privileges.
Acceptance_Criteria: Non-root container UID 10001; dropped capabilities; read-only rootfs; Minikube manifests with resource bounds and secrets.

User_Story: As a developer, I want tests and security checks in CI so that defective changes fail before packaging.
Acceptance_Criteria: 5-stage CI/CD workflow: checkout, build/dependencies, test suite, security scan (Bandit), container packaging.

User_Story: As an operator, I want security metrics and alerts so that failures and abuse can be detected quickly.
Acceptance_Criteria: 9 defined operational/security metrics; rate-limit alerts; p95 latency checks; health probes /health/live and /health/ready.
